headline: Japan's leading company interested in increasing investment in Bangladesh and setting up a second Kafco plant
summary: Japanese trading house Marubeni has expressed interest in expanding its investment in Bangladesh and setting up a second Kafco plant. A high-level delegation led by its CEO met officials at the Secretariat.
why: Marubeni is a major Japanese trading and investment conglomerate with a broad portfolio across infrastructure, energy and manufacturing. Foreign direct investment commitments shape growth prospects for host economies.
